newsitem.title: UK: NWE vacuum gas oil thin but supported by U.S..
newsitem.headline: NWE vacuum gas oil thin but supported by U.S..

text.p: NWE vacuum gas oil prices were notionally little changed in thin business but dealers said U.S. numbers were supportive to notional European prices.
Little material was seen available except for a Spanish piece which was expected to emerge later in the month.
It was being discussed in relation to the 70:30 formula, but prices were hard to assess on this basis.
Players pegged a small amount of U.S. buying interest at the equivalent of around $167 fob NWE.
High sulphur VGO was less well supplied and dealers said activity was thin, with the spread between high and low sulphur at around $12 a tonne.
